market.summary: GIFT Nifty points to a firmer open (about 22,840, +0.7% vs yesterday's 22,687.65 Nifty close) despite a heavy tech sell-off in New York, where the Nasdaq lost 2.6% on AI-spending worries while the Dow was flat. Asia is weak this morning (Hang Seng -3%, Nikkei -1.8%) and Brent is still near $114, so oil and FII selling remain the main drags; the regime stays RISK-OFF. Infosys reports after the close today (about 3:45 pm), which sets the IT tone for Monday.
